name: Accessibility Assistant – EAA ADA WCAG AODA
author: CartCoders

sections.description:
Ensure ADA, WCAG, and EAA compliance with Accessibility Assistant. Improve accessibility with features like Accessibility Profiles, keyboard navigation, text-to-speech, contrast settings, and font scaling. The fully customizable widget supports multiple languages to match your store’s branding for EAA, ADA, WCAG and AODA. Create an inclusive experience, reduce legal risks, and comply with global accessibility standards, no coding needed. You can just simply add the widget and it will be done.

1. Ease of Access for Visually Impaired Users
Accessibility Assistant enhances the browsing experience for users with varying levels of visual impairment by allowing them to adjust contrast, text size, cursor visibility, and reading modes — supporting greater independence and digital inclusion.

2. Ease of Access for Elderly Users
The plugin helps older adults overcome age-related vision or motor limitations by offering easy-to-use tools such as font resizing, high-contrast modes, large cursor, and keyboard navigation — making websites more readable and easier to interact with.

3. Ease of Access for Mobility-Impaired Users
For users who experience difficulty using a mouse or trackpad, Accessibility Assistant provides full keyboard navigation and interaction support, allowing them to browse, fill forms, and navigate menus without relying on a pointing device.

4. Ease of Access for Users with Temporary or Situational Disabilities
Whether due to temporary conditions like eye fatigue, injury, or environmental limitations, users can benefit from on-demand accessibility adjustments such as text-to-speech, spacing controls, and navigation enhancements — all without needing system-level changes.

5. Ease of Access for Blind and Screen Reader Users
Accessibility Assistant offers assistive tools like text-to-speech, image alt text tooltips, and improved keyboard focus support, helping blind or severely visually impaired users better access, navigate, and interact with digital content independently.

6. Ease of Access for Users with Cognitive or Learning Disabilities
Accessibility Assistant supports users with conditions such as dyslexia, ADHD, and other cognitive challenges by offering features like dyslexia-friendly fonts, reading masks, line-by-line reading guides, and simplified visual modes — helping them stay focused, reduce cognitive overload, and better comprehend website content.

Key Features – Designed for ADA, WCAG, EAA and AODA Accessibility Compliance

Accessibility Assistant for WordPress
offers a full suite of accessibility tools that empower users to personalize their browsing experience while helping site owners move toward compliance with global accessibility laws and guidelines.

Multi-language Support (100+ languages)
Ensures accessibility across global audiences by auto-detecting or manually setting the widget language, including support for EAA regions.

Text-to-Speech (TTS)
Allows users with visual impairments or reading challenges to listen to on-page content, enhancing compliance with WCAG and ADA standards.

Font Resizing and Content Spacing Controls
Helps users with low vision or cognitive needs adjust font size, line height, letter spacing, and word spacing for optimal readability.

Color Contrast and Brightness Adjustment
Provides high-contrast modes and brightness controls to meet WCAG 2.1 minimum contrast ratios, supporting users with visual impairments.

Dark Mode, Light Mode, Grayscale, and High-Contrast Modes
Enables quick visual theme toggles for users sensitive to light or color, aiding compliance with visual accessibility requirements under ADA and EAA.

Keyboard Navigation and Focus Indicators
Enhances accessibility for users who rely on keyboard-only navigation, helping meet AODA and WCAG 2.1 guidelines.

Skip to Content and Quick Navigation Tools
Improves user experience for screen reader and keyboard users by offering direct access to main content areas without unnecessary tabbing.

Link and Heading Highlights
Visually highlights links and headings to assist users with cognitive disabilities or vision difficulties in navigating structured content.

Image ALT Tooltip Display
Displays existing ALT text on image hover, helping users understand visual content and supporting WCAG-compliant media handling.

Pause Animations and Stop Motion Effects
Allows users to disable motion-based content to avoid distractions or seizures, in accordance with WCAG success criteria for animations.

Reading Mask and Reading Guide
Helps focus attention by highlighting one line or area at a time, improving accessibility for users with dyslexia or attention deficits.

Large Cursor Mode
Provides an enlarged mouse pointer for better visibility and control, assisting users with vision or motor challenges.

Content Scaling and Layout Adjustment
Offers global scaling of on-page content elements to make text, buttons, and layouts more accessible without zooming the browser.

Dyslexia-Friendly Fonts
Replaces fonts with clean, readable alternatives to reduce letter confusion and improve comprehension for users with dyslexia.

Color-Blind Mode Profiles
Enables preset profiles for common types of color blindness (e.g., red-green, blue-yellow), improving visual accessibility in EAA and WCAG contexts.

Responsive Widget for Mobile and Desktop
Ensures the accessibility tools work seamlessly across screen sizes and devices, maintaining compliance across all platforms.

Customizable Widget Layout and Position
Allows you to configure the placement, appearance, and branding of the accessibility widget to match your site’s UI/UX needs.

Supported Languages
English (en), Svenska (sv), Suomi (fi), Deutsch (de), Español (es), Português (pt), Türkçe (tr), Français (fr), 日本語 (ja), 한국어 (ko), עברית (he), Latviešu (lv), Polski (pl), Ελληνικά (el), Dansk (da), Italiano (it), Română (ro), Български (bg), Hrvatski (hr), Čeština (cs), Nederlands (nl), Eesti (et), Magyar (hu), Gaeilge (ga), Lietuvių (lt), Malti (mt), Slovenčina (sk), Slovenščina (sl)

Compatible with Popular WordPress Themes & Page Builders

Accessibility Assistant works seamlessly with a wide range of WordPress themes and page builders. Below is the list of currently supported environments:

sections.faq:
What does an Accessibility Assistant do?

Accessibility Assistant improves accessibility for users with visual, mobility, or other impairments, making it easier to interact with your website.

How does Accessibility Assistant help blind users?

Accessibility Assistant provides tools like increased text size, high contrast modes, keyboard navigation, and a screen reader-friendly design, making it easier for blind and visually impaired users to navigate websites.

Can I customize the accessibility options?

Yes, you can customize many of the accessibility features, including text size, color contrast, keyboard navigation, and cursor size. These can be adjusted to meet the specific needs of users.

How do I install the Accessibility Assistant plugin on my WordPress website?

To install the Accessibility Assistant plugin:
1. Navigate to the WordPress dashboard.
2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
3. Search for “Accessibility Assistant.”
4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate.”
5. Configure the plugin settings via the “Accessibility” menu.

What features does the Accessibility Assistant plugin offer to enhance website accessibility?

The plugin provides:
– Keyboard navigation enhancements.
– Text resizing options.
– High contrast and desaturation modes.
– Link highlighting.
– Customizable cursor settings.

Is the Accessibility Assistant plugin compliant with ADA and WCAG 2.1 standards?

Yes, the Accessibility Assistant is designed to help your website adhere to ADA and WCAG 2.1 compliance, ensuring inclusivity for all users.

Can I customize the Accessibility Assistant plugin to match my website’s design?

Absolutely. The plugin offers customization options for colors, sizes, and features to seamlessly integrate with your site’s aesthetics.

Does the Accessibility Assistant plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, the plugin includes a language editing page, allowing you to tailor language settings to your audience’s needs.

Is there a premium version of the Accessibility Assistant plugin with additional features?

Yes, we offer various feature plans, including premium options with advanced functionalities.

How can I get support for the Accessibility Assistant plugin?

For assistance, contact us via:
– In-App Chat Support from the plugin itself
– Email Support: support@cartcoders.com
– Phone Support: +91 84696 07787
– WhatsApp Support: Chat on WhatsApp

Does the Accessibility Assistant plugin affect website performance?

No, the plugin is optimized to function efficiently without impacting your website’s performance.

Is the Accessibility Assistant plugin compatible with other WordPress plugins and themes?

Yes, it is designed to work seamlessly with most WordPress plugins and themes.

Where can I find the Accessibility Assistant plugin’s documentation and user guide?

Comprehensive documentation and a user guide are available on our website.

How to cancel your subscription?

Navigate to the Plan page and click on the Cancel Subscription button.
